name: OpenFang
description: Runs scheduled autonomous agents from a single Rust binary, with seven bundled Hands, 40 channel adapters, an OpenAI-compatible API and an MCP server mode.

skills.name: Autonomous Hands
skills.description: Activates bundled Hands such as Researcher, Lead, Collector and Browser that run on schedules, with approval gates for sensitive actions.

skills.name: OpenAI-Compatible API
skills.description: Serves agents at /v1/chat/completions with streaming, alongside 140+ REST, WebSocket and SSE endpoints on the local daemon.

skills.name: MCP Server Mode
skills.description: Starts a stdio MCP server with openfang mcp that exposes each OpenFang agent as an MCP tool to external clients.

skills.name: OpenClaw Migration
skills.description: Moves agents, memory, skills and configs from an OpenClaw install with openfang migrate --from openclaw, including a dry-run mode.
